title: observability: add token-level KV cache metrics, dashboards, and alert tuning for cost/latency breakdowns
author: Priya Raman
description: Motivation: Improve cost and latency visibility at token level by instrumenting KV cache behavior and exposing token-level cost/latency breakdowns. This supports ongoing regressions we've seen in tail latency when cache hit rates fall and enables automated alerting tied to token unit economics. Summary: This PR adds new Prometheus metrics for KV cache operations, wires those metrics into the token-level cost/latency dashboard, updates frontend widgets in the Console, and tunes several alert thresholds to reduce noisy alerts while capturing real regressions. Includes backcompat: all new metrics are additive and behind an opt-in config flag by default for Dedicated/Private. What I changed: 1) Instrumentation: emit kv_cache_hit, kv_cache_miss, kv_cache_eviction, kv_kv_lookup_latency_ms histograms (labels: model, region, node_pool, shard, request_type, quantization_profile). 2) Serving runtime: lightweight metric emission from kv cache hot paths with sampling to limit cardinality. 3) Metrics aggregation rules: Prometheus recording rules for per-model token cost attribution and rolling window hit-rate. 4) Dashboards: new Token KV Cost & Latency dashboard JSON and updated Token Overview to include KV panels and cost-per-token breakdown. 5) Alerts: tuned three alerts (token_unit_cost_spike, kv_cache_hit_drop, token_tail_latency_increase) with staging/production thresholds and escalation routing to on-call. 6) Tests & docs: integration tests for metric emission and updated observability docs with examples and migration notes. Checklist: - [x] Add metrics and labels (server) - [x] Add recording rules and dashboard JSON (ops) - [x] Update Console widgets (frontend) - [x] Add integration tests (tests) - [x] Alert tuning and runbook updates (sre) - [x] Docs + upgrade notes (docs) Rollout plan: feature gated via feature flag obs.token_kv_metrics; rollout to staging 1 day after merge and monitor token_unit_cost_spike for false positives. If stable, flip flag for production during low traffic window and validate latency and cost dashboards. Backward compatibility: No breaking API changes. Feature flag default off for Dedicated/Private customers; hosted tenants will see dashboards enabled only when staffing the observability opt-in. Notes on cardinality: To avoid cardinality explosion we aggregate rare regions into region="other" and sample heavy tails on model-instance labels. We also provide a config knob (obs.kv_metrics_cardinality_limit) for on-prem ops.

Marina Gomez: Alert thresholds look sensible for staging, but I recommend a longer evaluation window for token_tail_latency_increase (10m -> 30m) to reduce flapping.
Priya Raman (author): Increased evaluation window to 30m and added a suppression window for known maintenance windows. Updated runbook with steps for on-call.

release_notes: Added token-level KV cache metrics, new Token KV Cost & Latency dashboard, and tuned alerts to reduce noise while surfacing cost/latency regressions. Feature is behind obs.token_kv_metrics flag.
notes: This PR addresses recurring incidents where increased cache evictions caused token cost spikes. After merge, monitor grafana:Token KV Cost & Latency > token_unit_cost_spike and SLO dashboards for 48h. On-call runbook updated in docs/observability/token-metrics.md.
testing: Unit and integration tests added; manually validated dashboards in staging against synthetic traffic replay; no perf regressions observed on internal perf canary.
migration_instructions: For Dedicated/Private customers: enable obs.token_kv_metrics via config and ensure ops knob obs.kv_metrics_cardinality_limit is set appropriately. See docs/observability/token-metrics.md for steps.
